A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TDA research work and contain all 20 pages, including Appendices A–F. Text and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of the prose, equations, figures, tables, and appendices.

before.justification: v2 reports original language-model evaluations, retrieval experiments, mechanistic diagnostics, and kernel benchmarks in Sections 5–6 and Appendices B–C.

after.justification: v3 retains the original model evaluations, retrieval results, mechanistic measurements, and kernel benchmarks reported in v2.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same length-dependent TRA threshold and inhibitory two-view TDA construction. The appendix pseudocode is unchanged.

E1.justification: Coverage remains FineWebEdu-10B training, six standard reasoning benchmarks, four SCROLLS tasks, and single- and multi-needle retrieval scenarios. No datasets or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged across the reported experiments. LSSAR is renamed LSSA, retaining the same Gao and Spratling (2025) citation, method description, and Table 2 scores.

E3.justification: Section 6 and Appendices C–E retain the same model configuration, data splits, training budgets, metrics, context lengths, and retrieval and timing procedures.

E4.justification: The Section 5 mechanistic diagnostics, Section 6.6 hyperparameter study, and Appendix B analyses of logit tails, survivor scaling, and cross-view correlation are unchanged.

E5.justification: Appendix E.3 retains seed 1337 and the single-run evaluation statement. Retrieval trial counts and uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged; no confidence intervals or significance tests are added.

E6.justification: Numerical results and plotted findings are unchanged throughout both PDFs. For example, Table 2 retains TDA validation loss 3.1190 and 99% sparsity, while the renamed LSSA row retains validation loss 3.1676.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, formal results in Section 4, and Appendix A proofs are unchanged, including the spurious-survivor bounds and non-dispersion arguments.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about sink-free, ultra-sparse, non-dispersive attention, competitive performance, and efficient Triton implementation.

C2.justification: Mechanistic interpretations and limitations concerning small model scale and dead heads are unchanged. Appendix B retains its qualification that the diagnostics do not exactly verify the theoretical assumptions.

D1.justification: Kernel details, retrieval prompts, training hyperparameters, tokenizer information, and hardware disclosures are unchanged. The code-access link is also retained.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. Replacing LSSAR with LSSA does not change the cited Gao and Spratling work or the description of its relationship to TDA.

P1.justification: LSSAR becomes LSSA in Section 2, Section 6.1, and Tables 1–2, and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. Other wording and section organization are retained.

P2.justification: Tables 1–2 receive the LSSA row label, with minor nearby text reflow and an updated margin stamp. Figures, table structures and placements, and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 only renames LSSAR to LSSA, updates the version/date stamp, and reflows nearby text. The scientific content, supporting evidence, reproducibility information, and limitations remain unchanged, yielding no meaningful net difference in overall quality.
